text: I wish that I was dreaming because the real Batman suit is made of titanium and Kevlar and of things I can't afford and things I don't even know exist, yeah, yeah. The real Batman suit is made of titanium and Kevlar and the real Batman has courage and he has money, power, respect. And I guess the Joker could tell I was nervous
